reserve_profile.summary: Bridge states USDB is always backed 1:1 by equivalent U.S.-dollar value. Its stablecoin FAQ describes a reserve portfolio containing short-dated U.S. Treasuries, overnight U.S. Treasury repurchase agreements, money market funds and cash, held in segregated accounts with regulated financial institutions.

redemption_profile.eligible_parties: Bridge documentation requires direct purchasers of Bridge Stablecoins to be associated with a KYC'd Bridge customer. USDB can be converted through Bridge orchestration into fiat or supported stablecoins.
redemption_profile.fee_text: Bridge states no hidden minting or burning fees for Bridge Stablecoins; orchestration or third-party transaction fees may still apply under applicable agreements.
redemption_profile.settlement_time_text: Bridge documentation describes Bridge-issued stablecoin crypto routes as available 24/7 with processing generally up to 30 minutes; fiat settlement depends on the selected rail.
